blocks.title: Third-Party Agreements exam shortcuts
items: Question gives uptime or response-time target → SLA
Need overall contract terms for repeated future projects → MSA
The MSA governs the broader business relationship.
Example: Liability and payment terms apply to all future work.
Need exact deliverables and project scope → SOW / WORK ORDER
An NDA protects sensitive information from disclosure.
Example: Vendor may not disclose unreleased product designs.
Parties want documented shared intent → MOU
Example: Two organizations agree to cooperate on security exercises.
Need formal responsibilities between organizations → MOA
An MOA is generally more formal about mutual commitments.
Example: Agencies document who provides which incident-response resources.
blocks.example: First identify the vendor-lifecycle stage: assessment/selection, agreement/contracting, or ongoing monitoring.

questions.q: A vendor contract requires 99.9% uptime and a four-hour response time for critical incidents. Which agreement defines these targets?
questions.explanation: An SLA defines measurable service levels such as uptime and response time.

questions.q: Two organizations want one umbrella agreement covering liability, payment, and general legal terms for multiple future projects. Which agreement is best?
questions.explanation: An MSA establishes general terms governing an ongoing business relationship.

questions.q: A project document specifies that a vendor will deploy 100 endpoints by December 1 and lists exact deliverables. Which agreement is this?
questions.explanation: A SOW or work order defines project-specific scope, deliverables, and timeline.

questions.q: A vendor will receive unreleased product designs and must be prohibited from disclosing them. Which agreement is most appropriate?
questions.explanation: An NDA protects confidential information from unauthorized disclosure.

questions.q: Two organizations document a shared intent to cooperate on cybersecurity exercises without creating detailed project deliverables. Which document best fits?
questions.explanation: An MOU documents mutual understanding and shared intent.

questions.q: Two agencies want a more formal document defining each party's responsibilities and commitments. Which agreement best fits?
questions.explanation: An MOA formally documents agreed responsibilities and commitments.

questions.q: Two business partners need an agreement describing how they will coordinate shared operational responsibilities. Which agreement best fits?
questions.explanation: A Business Partners Agreement defines how business partners will work together.
